text: As I enter this space, I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The environment, with its clean lines, glass walls, and prominent display of 'R + D'—research and development—invites me to explore, reflect, and engage with questions of innovation and the human relationship to technology. The scene sparks thoughts about progress and the collaborative nature of knowledge. I feel a little small amidst all these structured displays, but also stimulated, wondering what new insights may emerge here.
